work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CCXV 65636, synopsis 65638–65642, addressee 65644 and Urbanus self-protocol 65645 open the independent commission. Preamble and sections 1–5 continue in order despite section-2 OCR label at 65737. Local notes 65662, 65728 and 65802 belong to corresponding title/body markers and are retained; 65728 records the historical editor’s conjecture about missing words rather than a displaced body column or separately omitted insertion. Complete full/short dating 65822–65826 precedes CCXVI 65829.
